orgs.name: COASTAL COMMUNITY ACTION PROGRAM
services: Coordinated Entry for Grays Harbor and Pacific counties — the county's front door for housing assistance: assessment and referral into housing programs (Grays Harbor County Public Health directs everyone seeking housing assistance here first; coordinatedentry@coastalcap.org)

At Risk Housing: past-due rent or space rent, landlord court fees, and utility-only help if it will prevent an eviction — for households at or below 80% of HUD income guidelines who are behind at least the current month's rent
Homeless Housing Assistance: move-in costs and temporary rental assistance to move unsheltered or sheltered households into permanent housing, with required care coordination
HEN (Housing and Essential Needs): rent, utility and essential-needs help for adults with a DSHS HEN referral (incapacitated, no income or on ABD); HEN packs available monthly

LIHEAP energy assistance: a grant paid directly to your energy provider for households at or below 150% of the federal poverty level; may also help repair or replace an unsafe heating system, with weatherization referrals
Jail Re-entry Program: time-limited clean-and-sober housing, care coordination and weekly support groups for people leaving Grays Harbor County Jail who have a substance use disorder

Youth and young adult housing: rapid rehousing for homeless 18-24 year olds (YHDP), housing for former foster youth (IYHP and FYI voucher referrals), and rental assistance for 13-24 year olds exiting systems of care
HOPWA: rental, mortgage and utility assistance for people living with HIV/AIDS (per WA 211 program listing)
orgs.serves: low-income households in Grays Harbor and Pacific counties facing eviction, homelessness, or energy shutoff

orgs.name: GRAYS HARBOR COUNTY VETERANS RELIEF FUND
services: Help with rent, utilities, food and other needs for eligible veterans — a county fund of last resort established under RCW 73.08
Eligibility: honorably discharged, a Grays Harbor County resident for at least 6 months, and income below 200% of the federal poverty level

Applications are filed through local veterans service officers at veteran support organizations (such as VFW posts) — bring a DD-214, proof of residency and income, and any shut-off or eviction notices

County Veterans Ombudsman at Grays Harbor County Public Health, 2109 Sumner Ave, Suite 200, Aberdeen: 360-660-2640, veteranrelief@graysharbor.us (the fund's application line is also listed by WA 211 as (360) 532-8631 ext. 4069)
orgs.serves: veterans and their families in Grays Harbor County
